frozen_source_independent_review.actual_inspection: Complete unupholstered beech frame plus formed beech-plywood seat/back with qualified 1K PVAc/aqueous clear finish. Source catalogue versus component manufacture and supplier chemistry separated. Whole-chair net first-release kg, supplier upstream panel/kiln burdens and original Q_H service retained.

scope_reference_evidence.text_excerpt: This attributional method covers complete manufacture of a new unupholstered indoor four-legged chair with machined kiln-dried solid beech frame, purchased formed beech-plywood seat and backrest, actual dowelled/glued/screwed joints, qualified one-component aqueous PVAc glue and waterborne clear furniture lacquer, through the unique first finished-whole-chair quality release. Receive real stock and supplied components; cut and machine joints, dry-fit, bond/clamp, sand, apply actual finish with intermediate sanding/drying as qualified, assemble hardware/glides and inspect. Actual production sequence follows the approved drawing and supplier instructions; neither purchasing finished chairs for repacking nor releasing a bare frame satisfies this gate. Sources: `a2s-chair-catalogue`; `cegim-beech-production`; `konar-chair-joinery`; `kleiberit-pvac-303`; `adler-unistar-2965`.

The evidence is a transparent technical synthesis. A2S proves a complete unupholstered beech-frame/multiplex-seat/back product, not its unseen factory recipe; CEGIM proves industrial beech machining/sanding/press assembly/waterborne finishing; KONAR distinguishes bare frames, complete wooden chairs and glued mortise-tenon joints. The adhesive/coating manufacturers provide qualified technology examples, not a common current order, exact chair SKU or default recipe. The coating source separates normal-stress 1K from high-stress 2K use; actual chair suitability and acceptance must be established, never inferred from a furniture label. A2S size-specific catalog mass, source coating rates/temperatures/times and handbook densities are not PCR defaults.

Exclude upholstered seating, solid-wood-only seat/back routes without a reviewed component boundary, metal-frame chairs, bentwood/steam-bent frame manufacture, rotomoulded/plastic/rattan chairs, wheelchairs, swivel/reclining mechanisms, bare frames, single seat panels, onsite veneer/plywood manufacture, onsite sawmill/kiln/log conversion, two-component/reactive adhesive/coating, pigmented stain systems and onsite combustion or purchased steam/heat. Those routes need actual additional transformations and atomic exchanges before use. Supplier forestry, sawmilling, drying and formed-panel bonding burdens remain upstream and are not excluded from the product system. Packing/warehouse/handling/dispatch/returns are an actual original-cohort service account with its own observed horizon; no use-phase seating lifetime or service equivalence is asserted.

findings.summary: The defined exhaustive P/I/ER receipt partition omits a first standalone non-purchased packaging article.
findings.counterexample: Opening stock=0. Receive a first standalone gift/borrow/pool whole packaging article compatible with this actual pool (20 kg measured wet lot), with no paid-goods acquisition, no supplier-accompanied material and no earlier outward event. Retain all 20 kg at closing; no additions/removals, shipment or waste. Old P=I=ER=0 gives left side 0, right side 20 kg. It cannot be invented as an old return or repaired by a moisture/repair residual.
findings.expected_repair: Make actual paid whole-article receipts P (including proven bundled paid goods); make I a disjoint actual first non-purchased receipt, explicitly including borrowed/gift/pool and supplier-included cases that are not P; ER needs the same article earlier outward history. Update headings/cards/protocol fields and normative rules in both languages. Preserve full gross mass, wet stocks, original cohort/H, inherited service and one actual burden owner; no fresh manufacture burden solely because ownership changes.
